structured_output.rationale: All three lines denied CO-4/N822: required therapy discipline modifier (GP/GO/GN) absent on 97110, 97140, and 97530. Chart note confirms PT services under a PT plan of care. Remedy is a new original claim (CLM05-3=1) with GP appended to each line — not a corrected 7, which Medicare Part B does not accept.

root_cause.explanation: 97110, 97140, and 97530 billed without GP modifier. CO-4/N822 on all three lines. Chart note confirms PT services; GP (physical therapy plan of care) required on each line.

next_action.detail: Submit new original claim CLM05-3=1 (no REF*F8) with modifier GP appended to all three lines. Do not use frequency 7 — Medicare Part B rejects it. File promptly; the 1-year clock runs from DOS 2026-02-19.

evidence.fact: Lines 1–3 carry CO-4 + N822 ($189.68 total denied); no payment.
97110, 97140, 97530 billed with no therapy discipline modifier on any line.
evidence.locator: Loop 2400 SV101, all three service lines

evidence.fact: Note documents PT therapeutic exercise, manual therapy, and therapeutic activities — all physical therapy services requiring GP.
CO-4/N822 on always-therapy CPTs = unprocessable; remedy is new original CLM05-3=1 with modifier; frequency 7 rejected on Medicare Part B.

citations.rule: CO-4/N822 on therapy CPTs = missing GP/GO/GN; resubmit as new original CLM05-3=1
Medicare Part B does not accept frequency 7; new original only
